extraction.name: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
extraction.description: MTEB is a comprehensive benchmark for text embeddings spanning 8 embedding tasks (bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization) covering 58 datasets and 112 languages. It provides an open-source evaluation framework and public leaderboard to assess text embedding models across diverse tasks.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.rai:dataBiases: MTEB average scores are biased towards tasks with many datasets, notably retrieval, classification and clustering, due to task imbalance where some tasks (e.g., summarization) have only a single dataset.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: MTEB lacks very long document datasets (longest datasets have a few hundred words), has task imbalance (summarization has only one dataset), limited multilinguality (retrieval and clustering are English-only, no code datasets), and does not cover additional modalities beyond natural language.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: MTEB is designed for benchmarking and evaluating text embedding models across 8 tasks: bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, semantic textual similarity, and summarization. It supports training, testing, and validation use cases for text embeddings.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: MTEB is open-source with a public leaderboard. Results are versioned at dataset and software level and available in JSON format on the Hugging Face Hub. The benchmark welcomes task, dataset, or metric contributions and additions to the leaderboard via an automatic submission format.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Dataset created for MTEB using available data from Reddit posts. The task consists of clustering the concatenation of title+post according to their subreddit.
